_meta.indication: ANORO ELLIPTA is a combination anticholinergic/LABA indicated for the long-term, once-daily, maintenance treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with COPD, including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema.

pivotal_trials.design: 24-week, randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled trial with 3:3:3:2 randomization to UMEC/VI, UMEC, VI, and placebo.
pivotal_trials.population: COPD patients with moderate-to-severe airflow obstruction, an extensive smoking history, and dyspnea.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline in predose trough FEV1 on Day 169 (Week 24).
pivotal_trials.result: UMEC/VI 62.5/25 mcg provided a statistically significant 0.167 L (95% CI: 0.128, 0.207) improvement over placebo in 24-week trough FEV1.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥1% and more common than placebo) include pharyngitis, sinusitis, lower respiratory tract infection, constipation, diarrhea, pain in extremity, muscle spasms, neck pain, and chest pain. In 6-month trials pharyngitis occurred in 2% with ANORO ELLIPTA vs <1% placebo.
target_moa: Fixed-dose combination of umeclidinium, a long-acting antimuscarinic (anticholinergic) that inhibits the M3 receptor on airway smooth muscle to produce bronchodilation, and vilanterol, a long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonist (LABA) that stimulates intracellular adenylyl cyclase.
modality: Small molecule (inhalation powder combining two small-molecule bronchodilators)

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: ASTHMA-RELATED DEATH — LABA such as vilanterol increase the risk of asthma-related death; a salmeterol trial showed an increase in asthma-related deaths considered a class effect of all LABA. ANORO ELLIPTA is not indicated for the treatment of asthma.

rems.type: No recommendations for postmarketing risk management activities are made.

advisory_committee.vote: Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) met September 10, 2013; voted 13 yes, 0 no, 0 abstain on substantial evidence of efficacy; 10 yes, 3 no, 0 abstain on adequate safety; and 11 yes, 2 no, 0 abstain in favor of approval for airflow obstruction in COPD.

description.text: Revised the Indication statement and updated Clinical Studies with safety and efficacy data from the IMPACT trial

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for revision of the Indication statement and update of the Clinical Studies section with safety and efficacy data from the IMPACT trial, and for the alignment with current labeling practices pertaining to the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule.

summary.text: Standard review NDA under section 505(b), received December 18, 2012 with a December 18, 2013 PDUFA goal date; the Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee reviewed the application on September 10, 2013 and voted in favor of approval; approved as a first-cycle traditional (non-accelerated) approval with no REMS and no postmarketing requirements.

citations.quote: Please refer to your New Drug Application (NDA) dated and received December 18, 2012, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FDCA) for Anoro Ellipta (umeclidinium /vilaronerol powder for inhalation), 62.5 mcg/ 25 mcg.
A meeting of the Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) was held on September 10, 2013, to discuss this application.

No recommendations for postmarketing requirements are made; however, this recommendation is preliminary and subject to change after the Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee discussion of this application scheduled for September 10, 2013.
